name: Acolyte of Fire
description:
**Subclass Feature**

You become an expert at wielding destructive flames. Your abilities that have the Fire and Magic keywords gain a +1 bonus to rolled damage (already included). Your Hurl Element ability also gains this bonus when you use it to deal fire damage (already included).
